# Google Search URL Reference — Full Content

> 62 parameters. 55 active, 4 legacy, 1 dead, 2 zombie. Verified Nov 2026.

## The Template

{google:baseURL}search?q=%s&{google:RLZ}{google:originalQueryForSuggestion}{google:assistedQueryStats}{google:searchFieldtrialParameter}{google:language}{google:prefetchSource}{google:searchClient}{google:sourceId}{google:contextualSearchVersion}{google:contextualSearchContextData}{google:searchVersion}{google:sessionToken}{google:currentPageUrl}{google:cursorPosition}{google:forceInstantResults}{google:pageClassification}{google:clientCacheTimeToLive}gl=IN&lr=lang_en&num=20&start=0&safe=active&tbs=&tbm=&udm=14&filter=1&nfpr=0&pws=0&cr=countryIN&uule=&ie={inputEncoding}&oe={outputEncoding}&gbv=&kgmid=&ibp=&as_q=&as_epq=&as_oq=&as_eq=&as_dt=&as_filetype=&as_ft=&as_lq=&as_sitesearch=&as_rq=&as_occt=&as_nlo=&as_nhi=&as_qdr=&as_rights=

## 1. Chromium Tokens (18)

| # | Token | Resolves To | Status | Notes |
|---|-------|-------------|--------|-------|
| 1 | {google:baseURL} | https://www.google.com/ | active | Always |
| 2 | {google:RLZ} | &rlz=1C5GGLN_enIN999_999... | active | RLZ cookie |
| 3 | {google:originalQueryForSuggestion} | &oq=original+terms | active | Autocomplete |
| 4 | {google:assistedQueryStats} | &aqs=chrome..69i57j69... | legacy | Replaced by gs_lcrp |
| 5 | {google:searchFieldtrialParameter} | &sfv=v1 | active | A/B flags |
| 6 | {google:language} | &hl=en | active | Always |
| 7 | {google:prefetchSource} | &pf=s | active | Prefetch only |
| 8 | {google:searchClient} | &client=chrome-b-d | active | Client type |
| 9 | {google:sourceId} | &sourceid=chrome | active | Always |
| 10 | {google:contextualSearchVersion} | &csv=v2 | active | Feature flag |
| 11 | {google:contextualSearchContextData} | &csd=... | active | Contextual |
| 12 | {google:searchVersion} | &sv=... | active | Protocol |
| 13 | {google:sessionToken} | &st=... | active | Session |
| 14 | {google:currentPageUrl} | &cpu=... | active | Internal nav |
| 15 | {google:cursorPosition} | &cp=... | active | Omnibox |
| 16 | {google:forceInstantResults} | &fir=1 | zombie | Deprecated |
| 17 | {google:pageClassification} | &pc=... | active | Page hint |
| 18 | {google:clientCacheTimeToLive} | &ccl=... | active | Cache TTL |

| 21 | {outputEncoding} | UTF-8 | active |

## udm Values

14=web, 2=images, 7=videos, 12=news, 18=forums, 28=shopping, 36=books, 39=short videos, 50=AI Mode, 51=homework, 8=jobs, 1=places, 3=products

## tbs Values

qdr:h/d/w/m/y, cdr:1,cd_min:X,cd_max:X, li:1, sbd:1, ift:png/jpg/svg, sz:1, ic:color/gray

## Status Legend

- active: Working as of Nov 2026
- legacy: Still observed, superseded
- dead: No longer functional
- zombie: Present but no effect
